d.d: to bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.
A ball bowled so as to bounce at or near the batsman's popping crease.
d.x: He bowled forty-seven toe crushing yorkers that resulted in the wickets of 6 batsmen.

d.d: An inhabitant of Vermont who took the position that Vermont was by rights a part of the state of New York during the dispute over the status of Vermont in the 1770s and 1780s.
The Yorkshire terrier, a small breed of dog weighing 3–7 pounds as adults.
